za-r3-x.title: ZA-R3 / ZA-R3X
za-r3-x.desc: A SCARA transfer platform where ZA-R3 and ZA-R3X are primarily selected by SCARA arm length, suited to high-speed pick-and-place and compact workstations.

features.title: Two reach options
features.desc: ZA-R3 offers 450mm reach and ZA-R3X offers 592mm horizontal reach, making it easier to match station coverage.

features.title: Built for fast pick-and-place
features.desc: Maximum horizontal and vertical speeds of 1500mm/s and 500mm/s fit higher-frequency transfer cycles.

features.title: Stable repeatability
features.desc: Repeatability is rated at ±0.05mm, suitable for stations that need consistent placement.

features.title: Complete control interfaces
features.desc: Supports EtherCAT, Gigabit Ethernet, USB and 10 in / 10 out digital I/O for system integration.

params.value: 400mm Z axis: 24kg / 26kg; 750mm Z axis: 31.5kg / 33.5kg; 1160mm Z axis: 39.5kg / 41.5kg

za-r3l-m-h.title: ZA-R3L / ZA-R3M / ZA-R3H
za-r3l-m-h.desc: A SCARA lift platform where ZA-R3L, ZA-R3M, and ZA-R3H are primarily selected by column height and Z-axis travel.

features.title: L / M / H variants
features.desc: The family is grouped by column height and Z-axis travel so different station heights can be matched more quickly.

features.title: Fits vertical loading gaps
features.desc: Suitable for transfer tasks that need extra vertical compensation between pick and place positions.

features.title: Compact SCARA-based form
features.desc: Keeps the compact character of a SCARA platform while extending vertical operating ability.

params.value: Choose by station height and vertical loading travel first

za-r3d6.title: ZA-R3D6
za-r3d6.desc: 6-axis robotic arm for complex orientation and path control.

features.title: Flexible 6-axis posture control
features.desc: Suitable for tasks that need more orientation freedom and more complex path planning.

features.title: 540.5mm working radius
features.desc: Provides practical workspace coverage in a relatively compact robot body.

features.title: ±0.03mm repeatability
features.desc: Fits validation and operation scenarios that need stable repeated positioning.

features.title: Flexible mounting
features.desc: Supports any-angle installation and IP54 protection for different equipment layouts.

features.title: Dual-arm collaboration
features.desc: Each arm has 7 DOF, supporting grasping, transfer and dual-arm validation tasks.

features.title: Balanced reach and precision
features.desc: A 640mm arm span and ±0.1mm repeatability fit common tabletop and workstation-scale operations.

features.title: Selectable lift travel
features.desc: Lift travel options of 400 / 750 / 1160mm help match different bench and station heights.

features.title: Ready for integration
features.desc: EtherCAT, Gigabit Ethernet, USB and digital I/O make system integration and development easier.

za-m75.title: ZA-M75
za-m75.desc: Light-duty mobile base for flexible deployment and medium-light transport.

features.title: Light-duty mobile base
features.desc: With a 75kg rated payload, it fits medium-light material transfer and platform-style deployment.

features.title: Zero-turn steering
features.desc: Supports 360-degree zero-turn movement for narrower aisles and tighter routing.

features.title: Basic navigation and obstacle avoidance
features.desc: Combines map building and LiDAR-based obstacle avoidance for common indoor routes.

features.title: Complete charging options
features.desc: Runtime is about 10 hours and both manual charging and optional charging-dock setups are supported.

params.value: 48V@20AH ternary lithium battery; max output 800W; rated charging voltage/current 54.6V@5A
Manual charger; automatic charging dock optional

za-m135.title: ZA-M135
za-m135.desc: Mid-load mobile base for cross-station delivery and handling.

features.title: Mid-load transport capacity
features.desc: A rated payload of 135kg fits heavier cross-station delivery and material handling tasks.

features.title: Compact deployment footprint
features.desc: Dimensions of 674×456×327mm help it fit station-side deployment in tighter spaces.

features.title: Zero-turn and route adaptability
features.desc: Supports 360-degree zero-turn steering along with basic mapping, positioning and obstacle avoidance.

features.title: Built for sustained work
features.desc: Runtime is about 10 hours, with manual charging and optional automatic charging support.

params.value: 48V@30AH ternary lithium battery; max output 1200W; rated charging voltage/current 54.6V@10A
Manual charger; automatic charging dock optional

za-mr3m.title: ZA-MR3M
za-mr3m.desc: ZA-MR3M is an innovative composite robot platform that deeply integrates a high-performance autonomous mobile base with a customized four-axis robotic arm. By introducing a long-travel lift axis, it addresses the classic reach-up and reach-down limitations of ordinary mobile robots for cross-area and multi-height workflows.

features.title: Mobile Base for Full-Area Reach
features.desc: The high-precision mobile base acts as the robot arm’s legs, bringing autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance so the operating range can extend across the workshop or laboratory.

features.title: Simplified Architecture, Better Value
features.desc: The lift-plus-three-rotation configuration is optimized for logistics handling and planar operations, reducing system complexity and hardware cost while improving reliability.

params.value: Laser scanning avoidance, vision avoidance, emergency stop

za-mr3t.title: ZA-MR3T
za-mr3t.desc: ZA-MR3T is a highly integrated humanoid-style manipulation platform that combines a mobile base, lift axis, robotic arms, and vision cameras. With embodied intelligence, it targets human-like, high-precision, all-scenario intelligent operation.

features.title: Humanoid-Style Operation
features.desc: Inspired by human arm motion logic, it supports flexible multi-posture and multi-angle operation for complex bending, obstacle avoidance, precision assembly, and dexterous grasping tasks.

features.title: High Integration
features.desc: By integrating the mobile base, lift axis, robotic arms, and vision cameras into one compact system, it breaks spatial limits and supports cross-area workflows from factory lines to labs and service scenarios.

features.title: Embodied Intelligence
features.desc: With environmental perception from vision cameras and embodied-intelligence algorithms, it closes the loop from perception to decision to action for target recognition, path planning, grasping, transport, and assembly.

params.value: Laser scanning avoidance, vision avoidance, emergency stop

za-rmvr.title: ZA-RMVR
za-rmvr.desc: The embodied VR teleoperation development platform integrates a lift axis, dual robotic arms, dexterous end effectors, a core controller, and immersive VR devices into one teaching and research platform built around human-robot collaboration and data-driven workflows.

features.title: Immersive Intuitive Teleoperation
features.desc: Based on VR vision and pose capture, operators can use natural intuitive movements to achieve high-precision, low-latency coordinated control of both arms.

features.title: High-Quality Embodied Data Capture
features.desc: It records multimodal operational data such as vision, pose, and torque to support embodied foundation models and imitation learning with high-quality expert datasets.

features.title: Flexible Operation Across Large Spaces
features.desc: The lift axis dynamically adjusts working height, extending operation from desktops to multi-layer shelving and other multi-dimensional task spaces.

params.value: Embodied Dual-Arm VR Teleoperation Development Platform
1× Gigabit Ethernet, 1× USB3.0; 10 digital inputs, 10 digital outputs (PNP)
1× ZA-MR3T embodied dual-arm robot, 2× RH56DFTP dexterous hands, 1× Meta Quest VR headset, 2× controllers

za-rmps.title: ZA-RMPS
za-rmps.desc: Embodied dual-arm master-slave teleoperation development platform.

features.title: Real force feedback
features.desc: The master-slave architecture feeds contact torque back in real time so operators can sense resistance and stiffness during precise contact tasks.

features.title: High-fidelity mapping
features.desc: Matching master and slave arm structures support joint-level one-to-one mapping with low drift.

features.title: Fatigue-aware design
features.desc: The physical master arm provides support and gravity compensation for longer data-collection and operation sessions.

params.value: Embodied Dual-Arm Master-Slave Teleoperation Development Platform
1× Gigabit Ethernet, 1× USB3.0; 10 digital inputs, 10 digital outputs (PNP)
2× zero-drift robot arms, 2× RH56DFTP dexterous hands, 2× Eyou robot arms, 1× platform

features.title: Teaching and research platform
features.desc: Suitable for trajectory teaching, drawing demos, algorithm validation and motion-planning experiments.

features.title: Built on a 6-axis arm
features.desc: Uses a 6-DOF robotic arm to balance motion flexibility with path control.

features.title: Clear platform composition
features.desc: The arm, pen module, drawing board and optical platform make experiment setup and demos easier to organize.

params.value: 1× ZA-R3D6 6-axis robotic arm, 1× pen module, 1× drawing board, 1× optical platform

features.title: RK3588 integrated control
features.desc: Built on an 8-core 64-bit RK3588 processor with an onboard NPU for AI vision workloads and motion control in one controller.

features.title: EtherCAT real-time coordination
features.desc: Uses EtherCAT and a 1ms control cycle to support synchronized multi-axis servo control.

features.title: Low-jitter control
features.desc: Control jitter can be compressed to 5 microseconds for scenarios that require smoother trajectories and tighter timing.

features.title: Compact integrated architecture
features.desc: The integrated control architecture helps reduce dependence on external IPC hardware and lowers integration complexity.

rail.title: Rail Platform
rail.desc: Used to extend long-travel linear motion.

features.title: Adds long linear travel
features.desc: A travel length of 1750mm helps extend the robot's working range along a straight path.

features.title: Balances speed and positioning
features.desc: A maximum speed of 500mm/s and positioning accuracy of 0.21mm/300mm fit linked transfer workflows.

features.title: Modular integration
features.desc: Gigabit Ethernet and USB interfaces make it easier to use as an add-on module in an existing system.

rotating-platform.title: Rotating Platform
rotating-platform.desc: Used to add rotational freedom to the workstation.

features.title: Adds transfer rotation
features.desc: Supports ±360-degree rotation for stations that need angular switching and transfer alignment.

features.title: Stable rotation accuracy
features.desc: Positioning accuracy of ≤1 arcmin and repeatability of ≤10 arcsec fit posture-adjustment tasks.

features.title: Compact expansion module
features.desc: Useful as an accessory after the main robot body is chosen, helping extend station adaptability.

za-r3m-left.title: ZA-R3M(L) Rail Platform-Integrated
za-r3m-left.desc: R-series ZA-R3M configuration integrated with a rail platform for extended long-travel linear operation.

features.title: Extends linear coverage
features.desc: Combines ZA-R3M with a rail platform to expand straight-line operating range.

features.title: Fits cross-station linkage
features.desc: Suitable for cross-station pick-and-place, transfer and continuous linear workflows.

features.title: Clear combination path
features.desc: A practical option when the robot body is suitable but the straight-line travel range is not enough.

params.value: Cross-station linear pick-and-place and linked transfer
Rail Platform travel, takt time, and overall footprint

za-r3m-right.title: ZA-R3M(R) Rotary-Platform Integrated
za-r3m-right.desc: R-series ZA-R3M configuration integrated with a rotating platform for transfer and orientation adjustment.

features.title: Adds posture adjustment
features.desc: Combines ZA-R3M with a rotating platform for tasks that need angle switching during transfer.

features.title: Fits rotation-based stations
features.desc: Suitable for multi-angle transfer, posture switching and station-direction adjustment.

features.title: Selection tied to takt and layout
features.desc: Useful when rotation precision, takt requirements and station layout drive the combination choice.

params.value: Rotation precision, takt time, and station layout
